svg.title: GFS architecture and data flow
svg.desc: Complete overview of Google File System with master, chunkservers, clients, and the write/read paths including lease management and replication.

g.style: background: var(--color-background-secondary); border: 0.5px solid var(--color-border-tertiary); border-radius: 8px;;fill:rgb(0, 0, 0);stroke:none;color:rgb(255, 255, 255);stroke-width:1px;stroke-linecap:butt;stroke-linejoin:miter;opacity:1;font-family:"Anthropic Sans", -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;font-size:16px;font-weight:400;text-anchor:start;dominant-baseline:auto
g.text: After client ACK: Data is in replica BUFFERS, not yet on disk
Fsyncs happen in background. If all replicas crash, data lost.

svg.text: Chunk size: 64 MB | Default replicas: 3 | Lease duration: 60 seconds
